verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents official SDKs for Python (versioned Python SDK reference, with `wrap_openai` auto-logging LLM calls) and TypeScript (versioned TS SDK reference plus the official braintrustdata JavaScript SDK repo). Its SDK index states the SDKs log traces from code, and Go and Java SDKs exist as well. missing for 10: an explicit JS/TS tracing or wrapper example (the JS evidence shown is eval-focused), independent hands-on corroboration of instrumentation in both languages.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: Log traces, manage prompts, create datasets, and run evals or experiments right from your code.
Braintrust provides `wrap_openai`, a drop-in wrapper around the OpenAI client that automatically logs all LLM calls to Braintrust.
Create an Eval scorer that will evaluate an agent based on assertions on the generated trace.
A function you can use to define an evaluator. This is a convenience wrapper around the `Evaluator` class.
